cover: Sanctions screening for platforms that take payments

slides.title: Screen where every payment passes
slides.body: A check beside the main flow gets skipped the day someone adds a new way to pay.

slides.title: If the check fails, decline
slides.body: When the lists can’t be reached, a check that switches itself off protects nobody.

slides.title: Don’t say why
slides.body: Telling someone they matched a sanctions list is itself a violation, so the decline stays neutral.

slides.title: Record the passes too
slides.body: A log of blocks alone can’t show you screened everyone. Keep the clears on record.

slides.title: Test matching on ordinary names
slides.body: A naive check flagged six of twenty everyday donor names. One extra word of slack brought it to three.
